entries.positive_observation: Deeply receding dark-brown hair retains a bare high front crown, short dark sides/back, narrow sideburns and dark brows framed by thick round dark spectacles. The face has no moustache or beard and one sober closed mouth, with a near-frontal slight three-quarter pose, forward gaze and original crop. The dark charcoal-navy suit, white pointed shirt collar and plain dark tie remain without medals or shoulder ornaments. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or pinching. The complete pale warm grey-beige painted backplate fills the rectangle through every corner with its mottling and edge shading. The source is legitimately fully opaque; derived full and sheet viewing confirms unchanged RGB/backplate with no visible matte, halo, holes or backing loss and no invented transparent cutout.
entries.alpha_decision: RGB art was approved before the local alpha operation. The retained command receipt proves RGB unchanged and resized-source-alpha equality; source/resized/output corners are all [255,255,255,255], and source/output alpha extrema are [255,255]. entries.visible_limitations: The exact sparse crown-hair boundary, fine frame reflections and tie weave are not reliably readable at 156x210 and are not rejection grounds.
